model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, random_state=42), raw features, stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42)
notes: Zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi were kept as-is (not imputed). 57 exact duplicate rows were kept, so the test score may be slightly optimistic; 5-fold CV on training data gave about 0.84.
